Linear layer of the bicycle network of the City of Shawinigan.

! [Shawinigan logo] (https://jmap.shawinigan.ca/doc/photos/LogoShawinigan.jpg)

**Collection method**

**Attributes**

* `type` (`char`): Type

* `annee_resurfacage` (`char`): Resurfacing year
